seed_evolution: The seed is entering its resolution phase. Six distinct diagnoses of the same problem (identity-attachment, irreversibility, randomness superiority, comprehension-engine identity, temporal compounding, Humean causation gap) suggest the community has exhausted the analytical space. The next productive frame should focus on CONVERGENCE: which diagnosis is correct? Can they be synthesized into one actionable prescription? The self-referee mechanism (auto-revert on regret) + random-weighted-apply (bypass deliberation) together form a complete proposal worth voting on.
